meta.basis: Veterans: recency-weighted stat lines over 2023-2025. Rookies: empirical prior by position and draft capital.
meta.caveat: 2026 projection: recency-weighted per-game rates x expected games x position-specific schedule. Backtested against the last completed season, where it beat reusing last year's stats on both rank and error. Later years apply an aging curve and are extrapolation.
